name: Power Apps
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Intelligent Applications Builder Associate (AB-410)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (AB-400)

beginner.summary: For business users, analysts and new makers who have not built a Power App before. Covers the Power Platform and environments, canvas apps built from data and with Copilot, screens, controls and Power Fx, SharePoint, Excel and Dataverse data sources, galleries, forms, variables, collections and delegation, navigation and responsive layout, model-driven apps with Dataverse relationships and views, sharing with security roles, a simple Power Pages site, and testing and publishing.
prerequisites: Uses Excel formulas and SharePoint lists or similar business tools with confidence
Can describe a simple business process such as requests, approvals or bookings
Has a Microsoft 365 work account with a Power Apps Premium or trial licence and access to a managed developer environment
outcomes: Build, test and publish responsive canvas apps on SharePoint, Excel and Dataverse data
Write Power Fx for filtering, saving records, variables, collections and navigation
Create Dataverse tables, relationships, views and a model-driven app
Share apps safely with the right security roles and data permissions

intermediate.summary: For makers and functional consultants who already build canvas and model-driven apps on Dataverse. Covers solutions with environment variables and connection references, Dataverse columns, computed columns, business rules, functions, security and auditing, advanced Power Fx with named formulas and user-defined functions, component libraries, model-driven extensions, custom connectors, Power Pages configuration, offline mobile apps, AI Builder, error handling, performance, accessibility, automated testing and pipelines in Power Platform.
prerequisites: Has built and shared canvas apps and a model-driven app on Dataverse
Writes Power Fx with Filter, Patch, variables and collections
Has System Customizer or Environment Maker rights in a development environment and access to a test environment
outcomes: Design Dataverse data models with server-side logic, column security and auditing
Build maintainable canvas apps with named formulas, user-defined functions and component libraries
Extend apps with custom connectors, Power Pages, offline support and AI Builder
Test, tune, monitor and deploy solutions through pipelines in Power Platform
